column1: # landing unlocks: the landing, the fare item a landing there must not have dropped (0 for none), the unlock it shows, and
# where the trip must start: anywhere, or beside another balloon (a scroll landing near one is no flight). Only a
# balloon stores its fare, so only a refused flight unlearns one.
# no teleport: minX, minY, maxX, maxY, plane (-1 any), then the varbit that lifts the area once it reaches the value after it.
# Swimming by Mogre Camp: inventory, gear and spellbook are locked until five rocks weigh the player down; the anchor (2963 9478)
# climbs out; the cavern and the crab pen, both entered at y 9515 (walked live 2026-10-30), are outside.
# line skips: x, y, plane of a tile the walk goes through but the line steps over, running from the tile before it into the
# crossing beside it: the spear trap before the wall searched in Tarn's Lair pushes the player back.
# allotment patches: x, y, plane of a planting task's place, then its allotments' varbits. While every one has a crop
# still growing, the place is left out of the plan.
# allotment stages left: an allotment's varbit value while its crop grows, then the growing stages still to come.
# Written by gradlew bakeData from core's farming tracker (AllotmentStages); don't edit.
# use-up fees: half-ticks a route's ranking adds for a transport of the category that uses up anything (runes, an item, a
# charge, a daily or cooldown use; coins paid as a fare are free). Every category has a row.
